It is completely understandable that you are looking for answers, especially since the pandemic disrupted so many routines and made focusing much harder for a lot of people. While reading about adult ADHD is a helpful starting point, the best way to know for sure is to speak with a healthcare professional. They can evaluate your symptoms, rule out other causes like pandemic-related burnout, and provide an accurate diagnosis.

In the meantime, there are a few gentle strategies you can try to help with procrastination. Breaking your work down into very small, manageable steps can make tasks feel less overwhelming. You might also try using a timer to work for just 15 or 20 minutes at a time, followed by a short break, which can help build momentum. Be kind to yourself as you navigate this. Rebuilding focus takes time, and reaching out to a professional can give you the personalized tools you need to move forward.
